sideQuests.title: Fabric Mod Workshop
sideQuests.description: Java 21 client mods for Minecraft 1.21.11 on Fabric: Player Lock, Auto Mace Swap and Triple Swap. Each has a unit-tested controller layer; in-game validation is ongoing.

sideQuests.title: Redstone Qubit
sideQuests.description: A classical qubit simulator built from redstone using the stabilizer (x, z, r) representation. X, Z, Hadamard and measurement are built. A 2-qubit version with CNOT is planned.

sideQuests.title: Spindle
sideQuests.description: A Rust rewrite of an agent session manager, aiming for better Linux reliability, lower resource use and parity with native Windows. Work goes through issue, branch and pull request.

sideQuests.title: Android Demo Apps
sideQuests.description: Five small Android apps (cockpit replay, offline EV router, multitrack looper and more) with debug APKs built, 24 JUnit tests passing in aggregate, and emulator runs on API 35.

sideQuests.title: Canvas Todos
sideQuests.description: A local-only dashboard that merges SJSU and Ohlone Canvas calendars into one page of todos, announcements and my own assignments. Python standard library only, no API tokens.

projects.title: Transistor Fine-Tuning Study
projects.description: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with LoRA to predict 5 physical transistor parameters from semiconductor cross-section images, reaching MAE within 1.8-6.9% of each parameter's range on a 200-sample test set. Full fine-tuning cut error to 0.25-0.87% of range on axis-removed images versus 6.9-10.8% for LoRA.

projects.title: Qiskit ket_basis
projects.description: Added X- and Y-basis LaTeX state drawing to Qiskit's Statevector.draw so developers can read states directly in the basis they care about. Handles single- and multi-qubit kets, keeps Z-basis as the default, and shipped with tests, docs and release notes after maintainer review. Addresses community request #8014.

projects.title: Multimodal Enterprise RAG
projects.description: Retrieval-augmented generation over text, images, audio and video across 8 file formats, running fully on-device with Ollama (Mistral, LLaVA, nomic-embed-text). Qdrant hybrid keyword + vector search with OCR, captioning and transcription gives answers in about 10-15 s. Streamlit UI with auth, per-user storage and graph exploration.

projects.title: Minecraft Quantum Simulator
projects.description: A one-qubit stabilizer simulator built out of redstone. Three classical bits (x, z, r) encode the state; X, Z, Hadamard and measurement are implemented. A two-qubit version with CNOT to show entanglement is planned.

projects.title: Snake Programming Language
projects.description: An interpreted language in Node.js with a custom lexer, recursive-descent parser (AST) and tree-walking interpreter with scoped variables. Supports arithmetic, if/elif/else, while and for-in loops, lists with 5 built-in methods, range(), and clear lexer and parser errors.

projects.title: Flower Image Classifier
projects.description: A PyTorch VGG-16 classifier with command-line inference and GPU-accelerated training, reaching 85% accuracy on a 102-class flower dataset.

projects.title: Spindle
projects.description: A Rust rebuild of an agent session manager, targeting Linux reliability, lower resource use and native Windows parity. Built issue first, then branch and pull request.

projects.title: Fabric Mods
projects.description: Fabric 1.21.11 client mods in Java 21: Player Lock, Auto Mace Swap and Triple Swap. Controller logic is unit tested (17 tests on the latest Auto Mace Swap build); in-game validation is still in progress.

projects.title: Canvas Todos
projects.description: A localhost dashboard that merges SJSU and Ohlone Canvas feeds into one view of todos, announcements and personal assignments. Pure Python standard library, bound to 127.0.0.1, starts at login, no API tokens.

projects.title: LLMBot
projects.description: A Python LLM bot project. Recently patched certifi and Pillow security alerts with lockfile updates, a Python 3.11 floor and rerun tests.

experience.team: Advised by Prof. Hiu Yung Wong
experience.description: Multimodal LLM fine-tuning for semiconductor analysis.
bullets: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with LoRA to predict 5 transistor parameters from cross-section images (MAE 1.8-6.9% of range on 200 test samples)
Framed parameter extraction as a computer vision regression task with no hand-crafted features
Built multimodal datasets pairing images with gate length, poly gate thickness, substrate thickness, junction depth and spacer thickness
Benchmarked LoRA vs full fine-tuning on original, axis-removed and grayscale inputs; full fine-tuning cut error to 0.25-0.87% of range on axis-removed images vs 6.9-10.8% for LoRA

experience.description: Automation and data systems for a student-advising pipeline.
bullets: Built Python workflow-automation tools and reusable agentic task flows that replaced repetitive manual steps
Aggregated internship and volunteer listings into one deduplicated dataset using Selenium scraping and REST API pipelines
Designed data-collection systems for college metadata (test scores, tuition, admissions data) and integrated them with external advising platforms

experience.description: Java integrations and data pipelines for construction analytics.
bullets: Built Java integrations for two major construction APIs, processing about 50 records/day
Developed Java data pipelines with PostgreSQL storage for model predictions and scoring across 10 data sources
Automated lead extraction with Selenium and BeautifulSoup, generating 15 qualified leads

experience.description: Secure data handling for genomic data.
bullets: Contributed to a production team building secure data-handling protocols for 100GB+ of genomic data
Integrated backend operations with Python and AWS for scalable data workflows
